statement: Direct and indirect customers (Warren, 2 November 2026; settled decision 8, stated generically): a customer is direct when ASUS ships to a receiving site of the customer, and indirect when it buys through a distributor. An indirect customer's DC, where one exists, appears only as a site in that customer's own reports. One customer DC can serve several accounts of one retail group. Which sites are DCs is decided by the DC level rule, never by account name.
